_finding: Owner, 25.11 (docs/list-locks-tz.md v3, the 35 to 50 minute delay for new listings accepted): a record on the issuer list is called listed only when the chain backs it, the pinned Base prefix and the issuer factory having created it, confirmed by a second RPC where there is one. Anything else gets no verdict on every route; a held original is never offered instead of a look-alike.

mutations.name: the prefix is not checked
mutations.find: if (prefix && !addr.startsWith(prefix)) return { trusted: false, reason: 'issuer_prefix_mismatch', evidence: { prefix } }
mutations.expect: FAIL no issuer prefix on Base: held

mutations.name: no mirror trusts every record
mutations.find: if (!mirror || !mirror.last_ok) return { trusted: false, reason: 'factory_check_unavailable', evidence: null }
mutations.replace: if (!mirror || !mirror.last_ok) return { trusted: true, reason: null, evidence: null }
mutations.expect: FAIL no mirror, or one that never reached a finalized block

mutations.name: the second RPC is not required
mutations.expect: FAIL two RPC sources: created but not confirmed by the second is awaiting

mutations.name: a conflict is called before CONFIRM_MS
mutations.expect: FAIL ...within CONFIRM_MS of the covering scan: still awaiting

mutations.name: a held record is answered as listed
a held original is offered instead
mutations.find: listed_address: impostor.registry_address && records.some((r) => r.address === impostor.registry_address) ? impostor.registry_address : null
mutations.expect: FAIL a look-alike of a held original

mutations.name: the prefix is derived from the list
mutations.expect: FAIL the Base prefix is pinned, never derived
